answer: A farm padding one paragraph as a result cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. Since the nadir tally is stored with the zenith verdict, the voyage audit can re-derive it and a padded answer publishes the same claim repeated. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 6 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
